measurement_budget_followup.behavior: Explicit total measurement time uses calibrated cost to choose ceil(target * calibration_iterations / (calibration_elapsed * schedule_factor)), bounded by the iteration cap. Flat uses sample count; linear uses the triangular sum. Intermediate products retain full precision.
measurement_budget_followup.regression: Three flat samples at 100 ns/op with a 900 ns target now collect 3 operations each instead of the calibration power of two (4).

measurement_budget_followup.semantics: Airbug estimates cost from its final doubling calibration, whereas Criterion 0.8.2 uses aggregate warmup elapsed/iterations. Integer rounding, iteration caps and changing operation cost mean measurement_time is a target, not a hard elapsed-time limit.
